decision_basis: User approved bounded per-recipe household-applicability review on 2026-10-01. No blanket School2022 authority.

pass_requires: core preparation executable with ordinary household equipment
institutional logistics can be quarantined without changing ingredient/output/nutrition source truth
independent household corroboration for the same core cooking method
no new nutrient, yield, retention or quantity inference
review_rule.institutional_context_policy: Retain as provenance/source context only. Do not promote defroster/meat-shop, institutional holding/serving-temperature or procurement instructions to consumer RecipeSteps.
review_rule.nutrition_policy: Household corroboration is applicability evidence only. School2022 card/output/nutrition remains the sole prepared-output source authority.

candidates.title: Фрикадельки из говядины
source_core_steps: combine with soaked and pressed stale high-grade wheat bread and salt
place on greased tray, add water, bake 20 minutes
quarantined_source_context: thaw meat in defroster or meat-shop production tables

corroborates: beef meatballs are ordinary home main-course food
wheat bread can be soaked in water and added to beef mince
household meatball shaping and oven baking use ordinary kitchen equipment
beef meatballs are formed and baked in a domestic oven
water can be added to dense beef meatball mixture

candidates.rationale: The recipe-defining preparation is ordinary household cooking. Institutional thawing/serving logistics are separable source context and are not needed as executable consumer steps.
